title: 网络安全 · 渗透测试汇报 30 句
description: 面向渗透测试启动会、发现确认、风险沟通、正式报告与复测的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 在开始测试之前，请确认面向互联网的客户门户是否包含在授权范围内。
items.en: Before testing begins, please confirm whether the internet-facing customer portal falls within the authorised scope.
answers: Before testing begins, please confirm whether the internet-facing customer portal falls within the authorised scope.
items.notes: fall within the authorised scope 表示属于正式授权范围；whether 引导宾语从句。

items.zh: 书面授权不包括拒绝服务测试，因此我们不会执行可能影响可用性的操作。
items.en: The written authorisation excludes denial-of-service testing, so we will not perform actions that could affect availability.
answers: The written authorisation excludes denial-of-service testing, so we will not perform actions that could affect availability.
items.notes: exclude 表示明确排除；that could affect availability 限定高风险操作。

items.zh: 由于测试账户只有普通用户权限，我们无法评估管理员功能中的访问控制。
items.en: Because the test account had only standard-user privileges, we were unable to assess access controls within the administrative functions.
answers: Because the test account had only standard-user privileges, we were unable to assess access controls within the administrative functions.
items.notes: because 说明限制原因；be unable to assess 比 cannot 更适合正式报告。

items.zh: 测试窗口结束后发现的资产被记录为范围外观察项，而不是正式漏洞。
items.en: Assets discovered after the testing window closed were recorded as out-of-scope observations rather than formal findings.
answers: Assets discovered after the testing window closed were recorded as out-of-scope observations rather than formal findings.
items.notes: rather than 区分观察项与正式发现；过去分词 discovered 作后置定语。

items.zh: 除非客户另行批准，否则我们只会使用不会改变生产数据的验证方法。
items.en: Unless the client grants separate approval, we will use only validation methods that do not alter production data.
answers: Unless the client grants separate approval, we will use only validation methods that do not alter production data.
items.notes: unless 引导否定条件；that do not alter 限定验证方法。

items.zh: 最初的入口是一个配置错误的云存储桶，它暴露了用于内部接口的访问令牌。
items.en: The initial entry point was a misconfigured cloud storage bucket that exposed an access token for an internal interface.
answers: The initial entry point was a misconfigured cloud storage bucket that exposed an access token for an internal interface.
items.notes: entry point 和 misconfigured 是攻击路径汇报中的常用表达；that 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 单独看，每个缺陷的影响有限；串联利用后，攻击者却能够读取其他客户的记录。
items.en: Individually, each weakness had limited impact; when chained together, however, they enabled an attacker to read other customers' records.
answers: Individually, each weakness had limited impact; when chained together, however, they enabled an attacker to read other customers' records.
items.notes: chain weaknesses together 表示串联缺陷；分号与 however 呈现风险升级。

items.zh: 我们没有发现数据被导出的证据，但现有日志不足以排除这种可能性。
items.en: We found no evidence that data had been exfiltrated, although the available logs were insufficient to rule out that possibility.
answers: We found no evidence that data had been exfiltrated, although the available logs were insufficient to rule out that possibility.
items.notes: no evidence that 不等于证明未发生；rule out 表示排除可能性。

items.zh: 该问题仅在同时满足三个前提条件时可复现，这降低了被利用的可能性，却没有消除影响。
items.en: The issue was reproducible only when three preconditions were met, which reduced the likelihood of exploitation without eliminating the impact.
answers: The issue was reproducible only when three preconditions were met, which reduced the likelihood of exploitation without eliminating the impact.
items.notes: only when 限定复现条件；without eliminating 避免把可能性与影响混为一谈。

items.zh: 为了保护敏感信息，报告中的证据截图已经遮盖会话令牌和个人数据。
items.en: To protect sensitive information, session tokens and personal data have been redacted from the evidence screenshots in the report.
answers: To protect sensitive information, session tokens and personal data have been redacted from the evidence screenshots in the report.
items.notes: redact ... from 表示从材料中隐去敏感内容；现在完成时强调处理结果。

items.zh: 严重性评级同时考虑技术影响、利用难度以及该资产在业务中的作用。
items.en: The severity rating takes account of the technical impact, the difficulty of exploitation, and the asset's role in the business.
answers: The severity rating takes account of the technical impact, the difficulty of exploitation, and the asset's role in the business.
items.notes: take account of 表示综合考虑；三个并列名词短语解释评级依据。

items.zh: 虽然扫描器把它标为严重风险，但人工验证表明受影响的组件无法从不受信任的网络访问。
items.en: Although the scanner labelled it critical, manual validation showed that the affected component was not reachable from an untrusted network.
answers: Although the scanner labelled it critical, manual validation showed that the affected component was not reachable from an untrusted network.
items.notes: although 引出工具结果与人工结论的差异；reachable from 描述暴露面。

items.zh: 我们将此项评为中等风险，因为利用它需要一个已认证账户和用户主动配合。
items.en: We rated this finding as medium risk because exploitation requires both an authenticated account and active user interaction.
answers: We rated this finding as medium risk because exploitation requires both an authenticated account and active user interaction.
items.notes: rate ... as 表示评定等级；both ... and 并列两个利用条件。

items.zh: 业务负责人认为该系统不处理敏感数据，这一背景可能支持下调评级。
items.en: The business owner advised that the system does not process sensitive data, a context that may justify a lower rating.
answers: The business owner advised that the system does not process sensitive data, a context that may justify a lower rating.
items.notes: advise that 正式转述信息；may justify 保留评估余地。

items.zh: 如果公开利用代码变得容易获得，我们建议重新评估当前的风险等级。
items.en: Should reliable public exploit code become readily available, we recommend reassessing the current risk rating.
answers: Should reliable public exploit code become readily available, we recommend reassessing the current risk rating.
items.notes: Should ... become 是省略 if 的正式条件倒装；recommend doing 表示建议。

items.zh: 复现步骤从最低权限账户开始，以免无意中夸大攻击者的初始能力。
items.en: The reproduction steps begin with a least-privileged account so that the attacker's initial capabilities are not inadvertently overstated.
answers: The reproduction steps begin with a least-privileged account so that the attacker's initial capabilities are not inadvertently overstated.
items.notes: so that 引出写法目的；overstate 表示夸大。

items.zh: 概念验证只读取了一条测试记录，并未尝试批量提取数据。
items.en: The proof of concept retrieved a single test record and did not attempt any bulk extraction of data.
answers: The proof of concept retrieved a single test record and did not attempt any bulk extraction of data.
items.notes: proof of concept 是概念验证；did not attempt 明确验证边界。

items.zh: 请将请求标识符与服务器日志一并保存，因为两者共同构成可审计的证据链。
items.en: Please retain the request identifier alongside the server logs, as together they provide an auditable chain of evidence.
answers: Please retain the request identifier alongside the server logs, as together they provide an auditable chain of evidence.
items.notes: alongside 表示与……一并；as 引出保存证据的原因。

items.zh: 报告区分已验证的发现与未经证实的迹象，避免读者把两者视为同等确定。
items.en: The report distinguishes verified findings from unconfirmed indicators so that readers do not treat them as equally certain.
answers: The report distinguishes verified findings from unconfirmed indicators so that readers do not treat them as equally certain.
items.notes: distinguish A from B 是正式区分表达；so that 说明沟通目的。

items.zh: 凡是无法稳定复现的问题，都在附录中说明了环境依赖和剩余不确定性。
items.en: For issues that could not be reproduced consistently, the appendix documents the environmental dependencies and the remaining uncertainty.
answers: For issues that could not be reproduced consistently, the appendix documents the environmental dependencies and the remaining uncertainty.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句；remaining uncertainty 提醒保留不确定性。

items.zh: 首要修复措施是撤销已暴露的凭据，而不是等待应用程序完成全面更新。
items.en: The immediate priority is to revoke the exposed credentials rather than wait for the full application update.
answers: The immediate priority is to revoke the exposed credentials rather than wait for the full application update.
items.notes: the immediate priority is to 表达紧急顺序；rather than 对比处置选择。

items.zh: 输入校验能够缓解当前利用路径，但服务器端授权检查才是根本修复。
items.en: Input validation may disrupt the current exploitation path, but server-side authorisation checks are required for a complete fix.
answers: Input validation may disrupt the current exploitation path, but server-side authorisation checks are required for a complete fix.
items.notes: may disrupt 与 are required 区分缓解措施和根本修复。

items.zh: 若短期内无法升级旧组件，可以通过网络隔离和严格白名单降低残余风险。
items.en: If the legacy component cannot be upgraded promptly, network segmentation and strict allow-listing can reduce the residual risk.
answers: If the legacy component cannot be upgraded promptly, network segmentation and strict allow-listing can reduce the residual risk.
items.notes: if 引出资源限制；residual risk 指采取控制后仍存在的风险。

items.zh: 修复负责人应在工单中记录所选方案、目标日期以及任何已接受的例外。
items.en: The remediation owner should record the chosen approach, target date, and any accepted exceptions in the tracking ticket.
answers: The remediation owner should record the chosen approach, target date, and any accepted exceptions in the tracking ticket.
items.notes: remediation owner 指整改责任人；三个并列宾语使行动项可追踪。

items.zh: 考虑到该接口可以直接从互联网访问，我们不建议把修复推迟到下一年度版本。
items.en: Given that the interface is directly accessible from the internet, we do not recommend deferring remediation until next year's release.
answers: Given that the interface is directly accessible from the internet, we do not recommend deferring remediation until next year's release.
items.notes: given that 引出风险背景；defer ... until 表示推迟至某时。

items.zh: 复测确认原有攻击路径已被阻断，但相邻接口仍采用同一种易错的授权模式。
items.en: Retesting confirmed that the original attack path had been blocked, although adjacent interfaces still used the same error-prone authorisation pattern.
answers: Retesting confirmed that the original attack path had been blocked, although adjacent interfaces still used the same error-prone authorisation pattern.
items.notes: 过去完成时 had been blocked 表示复测前已完成修复；although 保留后续风险。

items.zh: 我们会把此项标记为已修复，前提是生产环境部署与所验证的版本完全一致。
items.en: We will mark the finding as remediated provided that the production deployment matches the version we validated.
answers: We will mark the finding as remediated provided that the production deployment matches the version we validated.
items.notes: provided that 表示严格前提；match 在此表示版本一致。

items.zh: 更改错误页面虽然隐藏了技术细节，却没有修复底层的信息泄露。
items.en: Changing the error page concealed the technical details but did not remedy the underlying information disclosure.
answers: Changing the error page concealed the technical details but did not remedy the underlying information disclosure.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语；conceal 与 remedy 区分表面处理和根因修复。

items.zh: 由于复测期间身份服务不可用，我们只能验证补偿控制，不能验证永久修复。
items.en: As the identity service was unavailable during retesting, we could validate the compensating control but not the permanent fix.
answers: As the identity service was unavailable during retesting, we could validate the compensating control but not the permanent fix.
items.notes: as 解释测试限制；but not 构成简洁对照。

items.zh: 管理层摘要应说明最可信的攻击场景，而不应罗列所有技术细节。
items.en: The executive summary should explain the most credible attack scenario without cataloguing every technical detail.
answers: The executive summary should explain the most credible attack scenario without cataloguing every technical detail.
items.notes: without doing 表示应避免的写法；credible attack scenario 面向管理层传达实际风险。
